svg.title: Behringer D MINI labelled interface
svg.desc: Partial grouped physical-control inventory. Positions are schematic, not a hardware placement drawing. Touch-key notes are virtual defaults. Deep MIDI parameters are available separately in the controls list.
svg.metadata: Symbol vocabulary: NYU ABILITY Project / IDM SynthAccess; https://github.com/IDMNYU/synthaccess/tree/ee1ef12cec3a3fb6be59a7861f7df8848be2dafe/tactileSynthGuides. Original schematic geometry; physical controls do not imply MIDI mappings.
